Refine your search terms. For example, instead of "Arathanai", try searching for "Aarathanai". Worship Songs names the song titles that matches closely with their Tamil counterparts.

The songs database and the app are maintained in separate Github projects. Worship Songs for iOS lives at https://github.com/mcruncher/worshipsongs-ios. You can request for a new feature by creating an issue there. Or you can use the Feedback feature within the app to communicate with us.
